headline: GMED's Q2 Earnings on Deck: Will Enabling Technologies Lead Results?
summary: Globus Medical will report Q2 results on Aug. 6. Investors will be keen to know whether Enabling Technologies and Spine strength aid revenue & earnings growth.

headline: Cencora (COR) Remains Attractive Despite Temporary Headwinds
summary: Carillon Tower Advisers, an investment management company, released its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the “Carillon Eagle Mid Cap Growth Fund”. A copy of the letter is available to download here. Mid-cap stocks delivered strong results, with the Russell Midcap® Growth Index rising 14.55% and slightly outperforming the Russell Midcap® Value Index’s 13.40% gain. Information […]

headline: Countdown to Cencora (COR) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Estimates Beyond Revenue and EPS
